in_sanskrit.name: Ardhika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Half, Part
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ardhika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Ardhika represents the half or part of something. It can refer to the god Ardhanarishwar, who is half Shiva and half Parvati, symbolizing the unity of masculine and feminine energies.
